title: Dick Tracy Veteran's Day Special #1
desc: TRACES OF WAR Dick Tracy is a soldier on the front lines of the deadliest conflict the world's ever seen. Today's assignment is supposed to be easy: Dick's assigned to protect a camera crew gathering footage of the glories of battle. But there is nothing glorious about war. And this one will haunt the detective-to-be for years to come. A hard-hitting standalone special from Alex Segura and Michael Moreci, with special guests Keir Graff and Francesco Scimonelli!
